selected_configuration.rationale: Still the DEPLOYED configuration (unchanged in this run). With the narration-style corpus expansion (233 examples / 20 categories), this run's validation accuracy for the baseline is 0.5429, while a VotingClassifier(LogisticRegression+LinearSVC) on a word(1,2)+char_wb(3,5) union with max_features=1000 reaches 0.6571. Consistent with the prior run: the deployed simple config does not win the sweep, but is left unchanged pending a decision, since swapping requires reworking predict_category()'s confidence-based flagging (LinearSVC/VotingClassifier hard-voting have no predict_proba). Validation folds are still small (35 rows / 20 classes, ~1-2 per class), so these deltas remain noisy -- worth re-checking once category_confirmed lets retrain_model() grow the corpus from genuine user corrections rather than more synthetic writing.
